Select approved drugs (max_phase = 4) with mechanism_of_action action_type 'CHELATING AGENT'. Join molecule_dictionary to drug_mechanism and target_dictionary. Return chembl_id, pref_name, canonical_smiles, max_phase, mechanism_of_action, action_type, target_chembl_id (as target_dictionary.chembl_id), and target_name (as target_dictionary.pref_name). Use INNER JOIN compound_structures to require canonical_smiles. Do not deduplicate. Sort by chembl_id, pref_name, canonical_smiles, max_phase, mechanism_of_action, action_type, target_chembl_id, target_name.
